handoff.summary: Added strict exact-target startup profiles and calibrated only Linux ARM64 development startup: 500 ms full and 275 ms empty preserve 9.60% and 9.17% headroom over the clean unloaded b22cf69 maxima, matching the original hosted-evidence margin. Generic and x64 budgets, both ARM SEA budgets, 11-sample normalization, and all raw ceilings remain unchanged. The retained first b22cf69 bench-arm receipt failed the earlier 425/225 calibration at 456.2/251.9 ms normalized; after the evidence-bound correction, the first and only clean unloaded da2e49c checker passed at 438.2/243.3 ms normalized with a 1.00x load factor. Exact-fingerprint Linux x64 focused, architecture, strict, portable (449/449), and changed-file (451/451) receipts pass.
risks: Startup timing remains host-sensitive; the profile is deliberately bounded by three independent 11-sample ARM receipts plus unchanged raw catastrophic ceilings.
next_steps: Preserve the exact 500/275 ms development-only ARM64 calibration and both the retained b22 failure and da2 passing production receipt through release integration.
Re-exercise the startup budget on the final protected ARM64 artifact authority before release publication.
